items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: I played at a jazz brunch from like 1990 to 2005 with a quintet... And the leader was named Jimmy Butts

ctx.x: Are there places in town where people still dance to jazz music?

Oh yeah, yeah, well big band jazz most times, yeah there is. Like Red Blazer too I think it’s called Swing 46 now. Yeah. Swing 46. And there’s a few other places. And then in other cities you get those, it’s very nice. So yeah I mean I was lucky. I played at a jazz brunch from like 1990 to 2005 with a quintet that was just amazing and it was always full.
